title: To designate the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Newark, Ohio, as the Daniel L. Kinnard VA Clinic.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the House on May 23, 2016. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

(Sec. 2) The Department of Veterans Affairs community based outpatient clinic in Newark, Ohio, shall be known as the "Daniel L. Kinnard VA Clinic."

summary.headline: Renames a VA outpatient clinic in Newark, Ohio, after veteran Daniel L. Kinnard.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Newark, Ohio, the Daniel L. Kinnard VA Clinic. It changes only the clinic's name. It does not change the services the clinic offers, its staffing, or its funding.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2016.
